title: Soft Watercolor Botanical (DALL-E)
description: Soft watercolor botanical illustration using DALL-E 3. Use for greeting cards, plant shop branding, and calming content.

prompt.main: A delicate watercolor painting of fresh eucalyptus branches with small white baby's breath flowers, soft green and white palette on cream textured paper, loose wet-on-wet technique, gentle natural sunlight, minimalist botanical art for a greeting card

explained.why: DALL-E 3 Natural style is more painterly than Vivid. Perfect for watercolor.

tutorial.intro: DALL-E 3 excels at natural language. Write prompts as full sentences, not keyword lists. "A watercolor painting of..." works better than "watercolor, painting, soft".
steps: Format: A delicate watercolor painting of fresh eucalyptus branches 鈥?full sentence + specific plant.
Details: small white baby's breath flowers 鈥?secondary plant.
Palette: soft green and white palette on cream textured paper 鈥?named colors + paper.
Technique: loose wet-on-wet technique 鈥?named watercolor technique.
Light: gentle natural sunlight 鈥?soft lighting.
Use: minimalist botanical art for a greeting card 鈥?final use case.
tutorial.tips: DALL-E 3 loves natural language. Write as a sentence describing the art, not a list of keywords.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "watercolor eucalyptus baby's breath, cream paper, greeting card --ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --s 600".
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3, style Natural. Same prompt as written.

faq.q: Why does DALL-E make everything vivid?
faq.a: Use style "Natural" not "Vivid". Vivid is for marketing; Natural is for fine art.
Full natural sentences. "A painting of X with Y" works better than "X, Y, painting".
1:1 with soft palette + named plants + paper texture. Prints at 4x6" perfectly.
